description.value: Laneway Coffee and Kitchen is an owner-operated multi-roaster cafe in Cumberland run by a coffee professional and a trained chef. It serves hand-crafted espresso and rotating pour-over selections from Canadian roasters alongside made-to-order sandwiches and elevated comfort food using local and seasonal ingredients. The cafe aims to bring the same culture of craft and quality found in a taproom to the coffee experience in a small-town setting.
